title: Meem sakinah: three rules in practice: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Meem sakinah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 35. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: Meem sakinah: three rules
points: Before ب: ikhfa' shafawi (lips nearly close, hum)
Before any other letter: izhar shafawi (clear meem)

head: Not this
This
rows: Hiding the meem before و or ف, as in «هُمْ فِيهَا»
Izhar shafawi: keep the meem clear before و and ف

keywords.def: a humming sound from the nose, held for two counts

questions.q: Read and name the rule: «أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ» (106:4).
questions.a: Idgham shafawi: the two meems merge with a hum.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: label six meem sakinah examples from Al-Fil, Quraysh and Ash-Sharh. Today's rota group recites all of Ash-Sharh.
Extend: find a second izhar shafawi in Al-Fil.
Stretch: explain the difference between ikhfa' shafawi and idgham shafawi.
questions.a: Ikhfa': before ب, the meem is hidden lightly; idgham: before م, the meems merge fully.

questions.q: Meem sakinah before ب is read with ...
questions.a: A) ikhfa' shafawi. ب is the only ikhfa' shafawi letter.

questions.q: Think again: A noon sakinah has four rules. How many letters decide the rule for a meem sakinah?
questions.a: Two special letters: ب (ikhfa' shafawi) and م (idgham shafawi); every other letter is izhar shafawi.
